children: Patrick Soon-Shiong disclosed a 19.9% stake in PDS Biotechnology Corporation. He filed a Schedule 13D on Sep. 21, 2026, following an initial PIPE closing on Sep. 7, 2026 that included stock and warrant purchases. The deal gives him a board seat and the right to nominate a second director while capping ownership at 19.9%.

Soon-Shiong joined the PDS Biotechnology board and can designate a second director as long as Nant Capital owns at least 15% of the company. He also agreed to buy another $10 million of stock or pre-funded warrants at a milestone closing tied to submitting a Phase 3 protocol for PDS0301, stating the closing "will occur no later than the fifth business day after" the milestone.

NantWorks, an affiliate, received an exclusive one-year option to negotiate a license for the PDS0101 program. All purchases and warrant exercises remain limited by a strict 19.9% ownership blocker, and Soon-Shiong may discuss strategy, governance, and potential transactions with management and other shareholders.

Patrick Soon-Shiong is a physician-entrepreneur and the founder of NantWorks, known for building and investing in biotech and immunotherapy companies. Through Nant Capital, he invests in and acquires securities and other assets, with a focus on healthcare innovation. He previously created and sold major biotech businesses and often aligns equity stakes with collaborative R&D plans.
